content.title: Barcelona vs Newcastle: Lineups, Substitutes & Injuries, Plus Where to Watch & Stream the Match
content.text: Getty Barcelona vs Newcastle: Here are the lineups for each team's final league game and Where you can watch the match. Champions League soccer is in its final leg of League action, with four matches scheduled. First up is Barcelona vs Newcastle. The other three matches scheduled for today are Liverpool vs Galatasaray, Bayern Munchen vs Atalanta, and Tottenham vs Atleti.The winner of today’s match will face the winner of the Tottenham vs Atleti match. The date of that match has not been confirmed. However, as of this writing, it is likely to take place on April 7th. Barcelona sits fifth on the points table, with Tottenham, Liverpool, Bayern Munchen, and Arsenal the only clubs above them.Today’s match takes place at Camp Nou in Barcelona. Here are the lineups for both squads, along with information on where to watch and stream the match. Additionally, the lineup information includes a list of injured players and substitutions.Ahead of the match, Google favors Barcelona. They list Barcelona’s win probability at 63 percent. Additionally, they give Newcastle an 18 percent win probability with a 19 percent probability of extra time needed to conclude the match.Barcelona and Newcastle have played six matches against each other. In those matches, Barcelona has won four, while Newcastle has won only one. A single match was played with no victor.Across those six games, Barcelona has scored 11 goals to Newcastle’s six.Barcelona vs Newcastle: Lineups, Injured & Substitute PlayersHere are the official lineups for Barcelona’s final league match against Newcastle.Barcelona Lineup (4-2-3-1) J.
